name: L-Sit
steps: Sit tall with your legs extended together and plant your palms flat beside your hips.
Lock your elbows straight, depress your shoulders firmly away from your ears, and brace your abs and hip flexors tightly.
Push forcefully down into the floor to lift both your hips and your straight legs completely off the ground into an L shape.
Hold the suspended position steadily for the target duration, then lower yourself gently back to the floor.
tips: Push down strongly through your shoulders so your torso stays lifted rather than sinking between your arms.
Point your toes and squeeze your quads hard to keep your legs completely straight.
